title: feat(metadata): the metadata list answers changedAt beside its items
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB2BRcLs2zJH6mZWG94VVuew)_
Fixes #36894

Part of #36890

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzgNtKtppbRbXmHGH8x

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — a read-only field of the list response that no author writes; no skill documents the list envelope's sibling fields (`registrations`, `disabledActions`)

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：Studio 的元数据列表接口现在会告诉前端每一项最后修改的时间（只有在环境里保存过的项才有），界面上的「修改时间」列由另一张卡来做，本次用户暂时无感。
- 为什么做：属于「Studio 统一列表」专题，解决搭建者在列表里看不出最近改了什么的问题。
- 出错会怎样：最坏情况是某一项的修改时间缺失或取错层，列表本身和每一项的内容都不受影响，可以直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

`GET /api/v1/meta/:type` answers a new optional sibling field, **`changedAt`** (name chosen per the card's suggestion), beside `items`, following the `registrations` / `disabledActions` precedent ("Beside the items, never inside one"): a record from each item NAME to an ISO-8601 instant in UTC written with `Z`.

- **Which items.** Only an item served from a stored `sys_metadata` row gets an entry: the row's `updated_at` (else `created_at`, the by-name read's rule). A code-shipped or file-loaded item gets none — never a stand-in (not the read time, not the boot time), the same rule as the by-name read's `Last-Modified` (`served-row-changed-at.ts`). Absent when no listed item is served from a row.
- **Which layer (card item 2).** The time travels with the CONTENT: each stored row's body enters the list's package-aware merge (`mergePackageAwareOverlay`) carrying its own row's time, so the body the merge serves for a slot carries the time of the row it came from and no other. So on the cross-package list (no package, the Studio's `~all` leg) and on a list scoped to one package, an item with several stored layers (its package's own row, the package-less row, the pair's declared override) answers the **effective** layer's time — even when another layer's row is newer.
- **Draft preview (card item 3).** On `?preview=draft`, an item whose pending draft is served (`_draft: true`) answers the **draft row's** time, since the draft is the content served; without the preview, the active row's.
- **Several listed items of one name** (a name two or more packages ship, a bundle's members): the latest of their times. Stated in the schema description.
- **Faces.** Only the served effective list answers it; `getMetaItemsForExecution` and `getMetaItemsPerPackage` (package export, form doors) answer none. The time rides an enumerable symbol (it survives the list's spread copies, as `SERVED_ROW_NAME` does) and is taken off every item where the list assembles its answer, so no returned item carries it and the registry never sees it (hydration reads the parsed entries, not the stamped contributions).
- **Nav contributions (round 2, L2 S1).** `applyNavContributions` rebuilds each `app` with `structuredClone`, which drops the symbol-keyed row time; the list read now takes each app's time off before that step and puts it back on what it returns, so a stored app with nav contributions keeps its entry. The helper's doc says only spread copies carry the time.
- **REST / runtime dispatcher door.** The `/meta` list chain (`createMetaListAnswer`, both transports) passes the envelope through by spread, but its per-caller gate and query filters drop items (`app`, `dashboard`, `view`, `book`, `doc`, `action`, `?names`, `?id`, `?object`). New step 8a drops a name's `changedAt` entry whenever the chain removed at least one item of that name (an entry is dropped, never recomputed), so neither a withheld item's name nor its change time is disclosed, including under a name another listed item shares (two packages each with a `d`); with no entry left the field is dropped. (Round 2, L2 S2.)
- **MCP door (measured, not changed).** `list_metadata_items` answers its own summary envelope (`{ type, count, items: summaries }`), not `GetMetaItemsResponse`, and carries neither `registrations` nor `disabledActions`; it is left as is.
- No item body changes; no `ui/**` (the column is #36898).

## Tests

<details><summary>Commands and readings (pre-merge head e1e67934d…0469803ee; merge of origin/main 7a43945db touched none of these packages)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test` → Test Files 368 passed, 9 skipped (377); Tests 23383 passed, 45 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest test` → Test Files 429 passed (429); Tests 8812 passed, 351 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` → Test Files 886 passed (886); Tests 28155 passed, 1 todo.
- typecheck metadata-protocol, rest, spec → exit 0.
- runtime import-side (wire shape): `meta-list-projection-parity`, `meta-list-protocol-fault`, `meta-list-read-gate-parity` → 3 files, 1421 tests passed.
- New: `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.meta-list-changed-at.test.ts` (18): items vs code-shipped, absence, unstamped/garbled rows, Date and offset normalisation, effective layer in both row orders on both lists, package-less stand-in, draft preview, duplicate names, faces and no symbol on any returned item.
- New describe in `packages/rest/src/meta-list-names-filter.test.ts` (3): gate-withheld and filtered names are not keyed; control.
- New describe in `packages/spec/src/api/meta-item-response-shapes.test.ts` (2 + a compile-time `Eq` pin): parse keeps the map; offset, local time, bare date and number are refused at `['changedAt', name]`.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (via scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored blob == HEAD, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

- Merge stamp removed (`withListedRowChangedAt(merged, changedAt)` → `merged`): protocol pin 15 failed / 3 passed (the three that stay green assert absence).
- REST step 8a removed (round 1): rest pin file 2 failed / 16 passed. Round 2, at b6ae895c: reverting 8a to name-only pruning fails the two-package case (1 failed / 18 passed); removing the S1 re-stamp after the nav step fails section 6 of the protocol pin file (1 failed / 19 passed).
- Both tests import source modules directly (no `dist/` in the resolution path), so no rebuild leg applies.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Owed: an L2 contract review (Clause ② surface `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`), not run here.
- File surface: besides `protocol-meta-list-reads.ts` and the new helper beside it, the stamp is three lines in `protocol-overlay-merge.ts` (the list read's merge, so the time is taken where the slot's content is chosen, not re-derived by name afterwards), and the REST list chain step in `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts` (the door re-shapes the list by dropping items). `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` records the new test's engine double (`check:engine-double-contract --write`).
- Choices for the reviewer: the duplicate-name rule (latest), the draft rule (draft's time), the `z.string().datetime()` instant with `Z` (the `draftChanges[].at` precedent; the producer normalises through `Date`, and an unparseable stored value gets no entry).

## Verification

Read first (by risk): `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-overlay-merge.ts` (the stamp after `transform`), `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-list-reads.ts` (pairing rows to entries; the take-off in the governed loop), `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts` (step 8a).

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.meta-list-changed-at.test.ts` → 18 passed.
